image_description: A night-time shot of a street sign pole with multiple illuminated signs. The top two signs are crossed, appearing to read 'ONE WAY' but with distorted, melting lettering. Below them are two horizontal rectangular signs with illegible, gibberish text that mimics the shape of words but lacks coherent characters. The lighting is high-contrast, casting deep shadows and creating a glowing effect on the sign edges.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Catastrophic failure of text generation. The bottom signs contain completely nonsensical character strings. The top signs attempt 'ONE WAY' but the letters are structurally collapsed and fused.

artifact_observations.location: Junction of top signs and pole
artifact_observations.reasoning: The top two signs appear to melt into each other and into the central pole. There is no clear physical separation or mounting hardware, suggesting structural fusion.
The sign panel itself seems to warp and bend unnaturally near the text, lacking the rigidity expected of aluminum or plastic.
